_comment: Per-provider launch map for the first, read-only task (ADR-0030). Read by scripts/lib/devteam/detect.py. Every provider in providers.ALL_PROVIDERS has an entry; tests/test_first_task.py fails when one is missing. Read-only is enforced by the provider's own permission mode (the `argv` flags), never by prompt wording. `argv` is an array, never a shell string; `{prompt}` is replaced by `prompt` with `{kind}` (audit|review), `{target}` and `{args}` (the kind's extra arguments from `kinds`, with a leading space, or empty) substituted. A provider with no read-only mode has `null` here and a `_why` sibling; detect then returns `launch: null` for it.

opencode.read_only_via: --agent plan (built-in plan agent: permission edit = deny)
opencode._why: devteam commands are registered as `devteam:<name>` and each carries its own `agent`, which overrides --agent, so a slash command would leave plan mode. The prompt therefore names the workflow in prose and the built-in plan agent, whose `edit` permission is deny, stays in charge.
opencode.prompt: Follow the devteam:{kind} command workflow for {target}{args}. This session is read-only: do not create, edit or delete any file.
